about.title: About Popli
about.subtitle: Empowering creators across India to express themselves and build communities.
about.mission: Our mission is to democratize content creation. We believe that everyone has a unique voice and story to tell. Popli provides the canvas, the tools, and the audience to ensure that talent meets opportunity, regardless of background or location.
about.vision: To become the world's most creator-centric platform where creativity is not just celebrated, but rewarded fairly and transparently. We are building the future of the digital economy.
